title: Last server joined (<game>/kiln/state/last-server.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by Kiln.Network on a client when a server answers its join with REJECT or WELCOME (handshake properties: server id/name, modpack, required[]). The launcher watches this file to offer a modpack (consent modal; nothing auto-downloads). 'history' keeps up to 20 earlier entries, newest first, without their own history.

outcome.description: vanilla: the server sent no Kiln properties (not a Kiln server, or an old one).

truncated.description: required[] was cut to keep the frame <= 7 KB.

missing.description: On a refusal: the mods the REJECT names (what the server refused for). Otherwise: required ids this client lacks or has with another hash.
